A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same RNE/RNC research. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–J support reliable comparison, including material that moved or was renumbered.

before.justification: V4 reports original molecular annealing, ligand-design, Gaussian-mixture density and energy estimation, and solvation free-energy experiments.

after.justification: V5 retains original molecular and Gaussian-mixture results and adds maze-navigation, discrete image-generation, and approximation-error experiments.

M1.justification: The core RNE/RNC framework, analytical reference, and energy regularizer remain. Appendix D.2 corrects the stated reverse CTMC kernel from a negative rate increment to a positive increment evaluated at t+Δt. New Appendix F.5 also evaluates an RNDE variant using estimated reverse-kernel variances instead of Euler–Maruyama variances.

E1.justification: V5 adds trajectory stitching on pointmaze-medium-stitch-v0 and prompt-reward tilting with CFG debiasing on ImageNet-256 discrete diffusion. V4's pocketwise QED/SA reward-tilting experiment disappears, while multi-target ligand design and the existing molecular/Gaussian-mixture coverage remain.

E2.justification: Table 1 removes the RNC-TDS comparator reported in v4. FKC, annealed-score sampling, Sumscore, DSM, and Dual SM remain in their corresponding comparisons; Dual SM was already evaluated in v4.

E3.justification: Added experiments introduce substantial new protocols: maze success-rate evaluation with 600 denoising steps and 10,000 particles, and CTMC image generation with 128 steps, 32 particles, and CFG strength 2. Appendix F.4 adds comparisons across 20–400 discretisation steps and different training stopping points. Existing benchmark settings are largely retained.

E4.justification: V5 Appendix F.4 tests sensitivity to discretisation and score error; F.5 tests whether the reference remains useful with improved reverse-kernel variances. V4's pocketwise QED/SA reward-tilting analysis is removed. Earlier RNDE-IS and LJ/GMM diversity analyses remain.

E5.justification: Both versions report thermodynamic-integration means and standard deviations over three repetitions, and retain the same SBDD uncertainty summaries. V5 introduces no new reported seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests, or uncertainty-reporting practice for its added experiments.

E6.justification: V5 Table 3 reports RNC success of 1.000 on all five maze tasks versus 0.288–0.714 without SMC. It adds prompt-alignment examples and approximation-error/kernel-variance results, while removing the RNC-TDS row and drug-reward plots. Matched ALDP, SBDD, free-energy, and Figure 5 numerical results remain unchanged.

T1.justification: V5 adds SMC-weight discretisation/score-error bounds in G.4–G.5 and particle-convergence statements with moment assumptions in H.1. The O(sqrt(Δt)) estimator rate already existed in v4 G.1 and is now also presented in the main text. CTMC, log-weight, and FPE formulas receive corrections, although new Eq. (133) omits the particle sum.

C1.justification: Both versions claim a unified framework for density estimation, inference-time control, and energy-based training, with flexible inference scaling and applicability across continuous and discrete dynamics. V5's explicit modality-agnostic abstract statement repeats scope already asserted in v4's contributions and conclusion.

C2.justification: Appendix B adds failure when the target is far from the pretrained distribution, and F.4–F.5 interpret approximation-error and kernel-variance effects. Section 4 removes the explicit superiority claim over Dual SM and the assertion that bridge applicability distinguishes RNE from it. Existing bias/diversity qualifications remain.

D1.justification: New Appendices I.3–I.4 document maze architecture, normalization, reward coefficients, masking/unmasking kernels, ImageReward construction, and sampling settings; maze hardware is also specified. Appendix I.1 newly identifies the FKC annealing variant used. These additions substantially expand implementation information without establishing changes to retained experimental settings.

R1.justification: V5 adds references supporting trajectory stitching, MaskGIT/ImageReward evaluation, reverse-variance estimation, and SMC convergence, including Luo et al., Ou et al. (2024b), and Mbalawata and Särkkä. It narrows the contrast with Dual SM, while retaining the established unification positioning relative to FKC, TDS, and density-estimation methods.

P1.justification: V5 locally revises the abstract and method exposition, shortens the conclusion and removes its Kierkegaard quotation, updates publication and author-footnote text, and expands appendix subdivisions. The overall section sequence and most existing exposition remain.

P2.justification: V5 adds maze/image Figures 7–8, analysis Figures 15–17, and a maze-results table, while removing v4 Figure 13. It repacks the LJ panels from a 2×2 arrangement into one row, relocates SBDD/free-energy tables, and clarifies discretisation-step legends. Several existing diagrams and plots are retained.

improvement.justification: V5 makes the previously asserted flexibility and CTMC applicability more assessable through maze/image demonstrations, direct error-sensitivity tests, and implementation details. Narrower Dual SM statements also improve calibration. The gains are limited by removed drug-reward/comparator evidence, unchanged uncertainty reporting, and defects in the new theory, such as the missing particle sum in Eq. (133).
